item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate trained successfully and achieved validation HR@10 of 0.625, with HR@5 of 0.47 and HR@20 of 0.785. Its best checkpoint occurred at epoch 15 of 35. This establishes depthwise factorization as a viable candidate, but no baseline comparison is provided, so improved generalization or superiority over unrestricted convolutions remains unconfirmed.","code_summary":"A causal NextItNet with 64 hidden units and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block contains two depthwise temporal convolutions followed by pointwise channel mixing, reducing convolution parameters while preserving a 121-position receptive field. It retains pre-layer normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, padding masks, learned position embeddings, and tied input/scoring item embeddings. Baseline training hyperparameters and host-owned training/evaluation remain unchanged."}
